style.styleTitle: Personalised Christmas Stripe Wooden House Ornament by PMC
style.toneOfVoice: Bring festive charm into your home with this Personalised Christmas Stripe Wooden House Ornament. Featuring a classic seasonal stripe design, this beautifully crafted wooden decoration can be personalised with 3 lines of custom text (Line 1: up to 20 characters, Line 2: up to 25 characters, Line 3: up to 25 characters), making it a thoughtful Christmas gift or treasured keepsake. Perfect for styling shelves or adding to festive displays, this personalised ornament adds a warm and traditional touch to any Christmas décor. Dimensions(mm). Height: 63. Width: 80. Depth: 3.
